title: Contrastive Adapters for Foundation Model Group Robustness

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance gap between average accuracy and worst-group accuracy on datasets where classes are heavily correlated with specific but irrelevant attributes, such as backgrounds in Waterbirds or gender labels in CelebA.

Measuring worst-group classification accuracy in toxicity detection tasks using the CivilComments-WILDS dataset, where text samples are organized into 8 groups based on the mention of demographic identities (e.g., female, LGBTQ).

Assessing worst-group accuracy across different fine-grained subclasses (e.g., BREEDS dataset), geographical continental regions (e.g., FMoW-WILDS dataset), product categories (Amazon-WILDS), or varying data sources (e.g., CIFAR) to test robustness against intra-class variations.
